text:
Noah wants to bake some vanilla cupcakes for his class at school.

There are 24 children in his class, but his recipe only makes 12 cakes! The ingredients for the 12 cupcakes are written below:

175g (6 oz) softened butter or margarine
175g (6 oz) caster sugar
2 teaspoons vanilla extract
3 eggs
175g (6 oz) self-raising flour

How could you change this recipe to make 24 cupcakes cakes instead of 12?

Perhaps you can find some other recipes and think about how many people they would feed if the quantities were doubled.
